title: Email integration
description: Inventory of outbound email: Send Mail steps (Step_ID 63) classified by delivery path (SMTP server vs. email client), with the extracted SMTP host and a flag for hard-coded credentials (security-relevant), plus MBS SendMail calls. cURL-SMTP downloads stay in the APIs dashboard.
author: fm-lab

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter (from the app-level filter).

params.name: mode
params.description: Restricts the detail list to a delivery mode (SMTP / Client / MBS / unknown). 'All' (or empty) lifts the filter.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows returned by the detail list.
